b7_4b_verdict_correction: B7.4B BLOCKED - SELECTED WORKFLOW NOT OPERABLE. Five public routes alone do not constitute the authorized controlled pilot. The controlled pilot is an approved-user, read-only AURA experience.

authorized_decisions.reset_password_route_status: ABSENT - not declared in src/App.tsx; recovery-completion is BROKEN
authorized_decisions.recovery_workflow_status: NOT OPERABLE - entry page functions; completion page missing; overall workflow is not counted as a completed pilot workflow
authorized_decisions.minimum_role: standard non-privileged approved user (no security_admin, no elevated role introduced)
authorized_decisions.default_policy: default-deny for every route and every function unless explicitly included via evidence process

write_deferred_routes./onboarding: performs supabase.from('onboarding_submissions').insert(...); a write-enabled route cannot be a read-only public-pilot route and is deferred until write authorization is separately in-scope

approved_user_pilot_blocking_reasons: Every candidate approved-user route in src/App.tsx renders inside <Layout>, which mounts CoPilotPanel/CoPilotBubble (copilot-search, copilot-chat-simple), HealthBadges (health), useTokenRefresh (zapier-auto-refresh, zapier-refresh-token) and GlobalSearchBar suggestions (search-suggestions) plus AOCQuickAccessButton and DataCentreSelector. These are on the explicit exclusion list.

The nearest AURA overview (Dashboard) invokes ai-systems-unified on initial render and offers systems-delete as a permitted action; the fallback path renders fabricated rows and hardcoded metrics on non-2xx.
The nearest telemetry surfaces (/analytics, /operations, /intelligence) invoke ops-overview on initial render.
No existing approved-user route provides a truthful read-only asset or metric inspection without either mounting Layout or invoking a blocked function.

Making the approved-user pilot operable requires: (a) a new pilot-safe layout shell that does not import CoPilot providers, health badges, zapier hooks or search suggestions; AND (b) new read-only overview and inspection pages that source from direct RLS-guarded table reads or from allowlisted functions. Neither exists. The user's guidance permits a minimal pilot-safe shell but not new product capabilities; the required overview/inspection pages are product capabilities.

Effective remote RLS cannot be verified locally in the sandbox; any 'zero-edge-function' claim that relies on direct table reads would still be UNVERIFIED against production and is classified as an external blocker.
excluded_capabilities: every write operation (except supabase.auth.* SDK writes for sign-in / sign-out / password-reset entry)
verdict: APPROVED-USER PILOT BLOCKED. Public shell (4 read-only routes) is operable; that does not satisfy the controlled pilot definition.
